meta.notes: A wall that joins other walls and solid blocks and is too high to jump over. Mined with a stone pickaxe or better, as copper. Bronze Wall: on random ticks it slowly ages into the exposed stage, msm_examples:exposed_bronze_wall, by copper's own chance, and a lower-stage neighbour holds it back. Honeycomb waxes it into msm_examples:waxed_bronze_wall.
